description: Observed weighted fatal / KA shares by exposure level (crude numerators and denominators; flag: suppressed n<30, unstable RSE>30%)
population: CRSS police-reported crashes 2016-2024 with a determinable NHTSA-imputed maximum severity (MAXSEV_IM 0-4)
method: Weighted proportions, Taylor-linearised SEs, logit CIs
